headline: Kai, a December rate hike is now the market's base case, and this morning's PPI report is its first real test.
subline: Nvidia heads into Tuesday's earnings without a CEO, the 10-year touched 5.10%, and bitcoin broke below $70,000.
asof: Pre-market · as of ≈6:40 AM ET · index strip shows futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: October PPI lands this morning
items.sentence: TipRanks asks whether a cooler wholesale-inflation print can give stocks a boost, with Wall Street wobbling into the release after a hot October CPI.

items.title: 10-year hits its highest level since October
items.sentence: Thursday's bond selloff pushed the yield to 5.10%, per Yahoo Finance, which notes traders are bracing for a December rate hike.

items.title: Nvidia's 4.3% slide drags the S&P 500
items.sentence: Jensen Huang's resignation sent the stock down 4.3% and the index to 7,592.40 Thursday, per BBN Times, and interim CEO Colette Kress now fronts Tuesday's earnings report.

items.title: Applied Materials beats; revenue jumps 53%
items.sentence: The chip-toolmaker topped estimates with revenue up 53%, per Coruzant, a rare piece of good chip news this week.

items.title: Bitcoin breaks below $70,000
items.sentence: The dip triggered roughly $1.2 billion in liquidations as the selloff gathered pace, per CoinDesk.

items.title: US envoys meet Zelensky after Putin talks
items.sentence: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner saw Zelensky in Dublin after their Moscow session with Putin, per CNN, as Ukraine reported Starshield access was restricted again.

items.title: Van Hollen challenges Schumer for Senate leader
items.sentence: Bernie Sanders endorsed the Maryland Democrat's bid to replace Chuck Schumer as Senate Democratic leader, per Fox News, after last week's midterm sweep.

items.title: Xi: Taiwan 'reunification' must happen
items.sentence: Xi said history 'cannot be stopped' in a speech marking Sun Yat-sen's anniversary, per NBC News, and Taipei replied that the remarks offered nothing new.

items.title: DR Congo Ebola deaths pass 5,300
items.sentence: The death toll has passed 5,300, per Al Jazeera, and Doctors Without Borders says the six-month-old outbreak remains out of control.

items.title: Peltola clings to lead in Alaska count
items.sentence: Democrat Mary Peltola leads Sen. Dan Sullivan by about 600 votes with counting unfinished, per Quartz, more than a week after election day.

items.title: Lawsuit seeks halt to frontier AI development
items.sentence: Nonprofits including Public Citizen asked a San Francisco court to bar OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta and SpaceX's AI unit from building more advanced models, per Reuters.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage knocked out Outlook, Teams
items.sentence: The widespread disruption took down Outlook and other 365 services for hours Thursday, per CNBC, with Copilot hit as well.

items.title: North Korea stole $400 million via deepfake calls
items.sentence: Hackers posed as executives on video calls to carry out the crypto theft, per the Justice Department, which announced actions to disrupt the operation.

items.title: Australian regulator warns of AI 'interruptions'
items.sentence: APRA cautioned that financial firms should expect disruption as models from Anthropic, OpenAI and others evolve, per ABC News Australia.
